name: F3300
summary: High-speed industrial FDM: Stratasys says it prints up to twice as fast as competing platforms. 600 × 600 × 800 mm build.

page.description: Stratasys F3300 industrial FDM 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia.
page.headline: Faster throughput.
page.lead: Stratasys says the F3300 prints up to twice as fast as competing extrusion platforms. It has four extruders, autocalibration and onboard material dryers, so it can run predictable production around the clock.
page.footnote: * or ±0.0015 mm/mm, whichever is greater. † Stratasys claim. Source: stratasys.com F3300 page, read 16 Oct 2026.
page.features_heading: Engineered for the factory, not the lab.

features.title: Faster gantry speeds
features.text: Faster point-to-point material deposition cuts time-to-part.

features.title: Multiple extruders
features.text: Redundancy for higher reliability, and no idle time from single-extruder thermal cycling.

features.title: Autocalibration
features.text: No manual calibration after a material change.

features.title: Multi-resolution printing
features.text: Small and large bead thicknesses in the same job to finish parts sooner.

features.title: Faster extrusion
features.text: New extruder technology for higher throughput.

benefits.title: Lower cost per part
benefits.text: Faster printing, more efficient material use and higher part yield.

benefits.title: Up to 2× throughput
benefits.text: Prints up to twice the rate of other extrusion systems (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: Production reliability
benefits.text: Predictable performance and part yield on the factory floor.

benefits.title: Less labour
benefits.text: Ease of use, including autocalibration, cuts operator time.

specs.label: Description
specs.value: High-speed industrial 3D printer. Benchmark FDM® reliability and quality, with up to twice the print speed of competitive platforms.

specs.label: Material delivery
specs.value: 4 material spool bays feeding 4 extruders; mix-and-match model or support; independently controlled onboard material dryers (120 °C max)

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: XY ±0.089 mm or ±0.0015 mm/mm, whichever is greater. Z ±0.200 mm or ±0.002 mm/mm, plus 1 layer height

specs.label: Software
specs.value: GrabCAD Print, GrabCAD Print Pro, Insight, MTConnect enabled

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE (Machinery Directive & EMC) 2006/42/EC, cTUVus, FCC Part B

page.applications_heading: Prototypes, tooling and production parts on one platform.
page.applications_text: Used in automotive, aerospace, rail, medical and general manufacturing, where speed, reliability and cost efficiency matter.

applications.title: Rapid prototyping
applications.text: Durable functional prototypes in production thermoplastics.

applications.title: Manufacturing tooling
applications.text: Jigs, fixtures and masking tools without machining lead times.

page.pricing_heading: Get F3300 pricing and expert guidance.
page.pricing_text: Talk to an FDM specialist about your application. We’ll walk through pricing and a test print of your own part at AMIC.
